    c = s[i]

                inside_parentheses = False
    if c == '(':
        inside_parentheses = True

if current_count > 0:
    max_sequence = max(max_sequence, current_count)

if max_sequence == -1:
    print(0, end=' ')
else:
    print(max_sequence, end=' ')
print(total_numbers)
